name: Free Online Long Screenshot & Vertical Image Stitcher - ATools
description: Free online long screenshot tool: Drag & drop or paste (Ctrl+V) multiple screenshots to seamlessly stitch into a high-resolution long image. Pure client-side processing.
seoDescription: Free online long screenshot and vertical image stitcher. Drag & drop images or press Ctrl+V / Cmd+V anywhere to quickly paste multiple screenshots (e.g. mobile chats, web pages, feeds). Features smart width matching, gap, padding, and corner radius styling. Exports high-resolution PNG long screenshots in real time. Pure client-side Canvas processing, private and secure.

ui.extensionGuideTitle: How to capture full-page scrolling screenshots of online websites?
ui.extensionGuideSubtitle: Due to browser Same-Origin Policy (SOP) restrictions, ordinary web pages cannot directly capture external third-party websites. To capture external live websites, you can install the ATools Chrome Extension to capture the current active tab seamlessly.
extensionGuideSteps: Open the ATools extension side panel on the webpage you want to capture;
Click the 'Long Screenshot' button; the extension will automatically scroll and stitch the page;
Download the complete full-page PNG image with one click.
